title: check-where-matcher-conformance: the lifter reads identifiers out of template-literal text, so a refusal message's words pull sibling bindings into the lift and the matcher reads unjudged
body:
domain:server#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZUR3xvHyDPCjNL5P4

Filing gate: ① A class-a out-of-scope finding from the #29538 dev (os-dev-report 6598582500, out-of-scope item 2), accepted by the seat on PR #29858. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. This is an instrument false unjudged: the matcher was conforming, and only the words of a string beside it broke the lift.

## What happens

`scripts/check-where-matcher-conformance.mjs` lifts a test double's WHERE matcher into a callable (`buildCallable`). It collects the free identifiers the matcher needs with `identifiersIn`. `identifiersIn` also reads identifiers out of template-literal TEXT, not only out of its `${…}` holes. In `packages/objectql/src/write-answer-declared-columns.test.ts`, a fake's refusal message contained the words "sparse driver". That made the lifter pull the sibling `driver` literal, and its `name` shorthand, into the lift. The lift then threw `ReferenceError: name is not defined`, and the gate reported `NEW silently-wrong WHERE matcher (0 silent, 1 unjudged). line 46 matches: could not lift: ReferenceError: name is not defined`.

The dev renamed the message text, and the same matcher read CONFORMING.

**Reach** (real producer): on the PR #29858 branch, the file above was refused as described until the message text was renamed.

## Business reason

A double's refusal message is free prose. When a gate's verdict depends on which English words a string contains, authors learn to word-smith messages to satisfy the gate, and a wrong word turns a conforming matcher into an unjudged one that blocks the PR.

## Wanted

- `identifiersIn` reads identifiers only from code: a template literal's `${…}` expressions and never its quasis. Ordinary string literals already behave this way.
- A self-test case: a matcher beside a template literal whose text names a sibling binding lifts and judges CONFORMING.

## Reader

A `domain:server` seat, or the devx lane if the coordinator routes instruments there. The surface is the checker and its `--self-test`.

## Dedupe

Searched `is:issue where-matcher template literal` (218 hits, none on the lifter) and `is:issue where-matcher "could not lift"` (8 hits, none on template text). The nearest are #8582 and #7620 (closed; matcher semantics, not lifting). **New.**

Links back: #29538, PR #29858.
